Type checking error cases. Each case starts with "-- name --" and is named
after the first error code it must produce. A case is one template, a.hx,
unless it has "== file ==" lines, which start separate files. Every case
also gets models.go.txt as models.go unless it provides its own.

-- TC301_unknown_name --
component A(todos []Todo)
<p>{todo}</p>
-- TC301_unknown_name_no_suggestion --
component A(todos []Todo)
<p>{zebra}</p>
-- TC302_unknown_field --
component A(t Todo)
<p>{t.titel}</p>
-- TC302_go_field_name --
component A(t Todo)
<p>{t.Title}</p>
-- TC303_field_on_string --
component A(name string)
<p>{name.length}</p>

<p>x</p>
-- TC304_go_float --

<p>{price}</p>

-- TC305_string_plus_int --

<p>{name + n}</p>
-- TC305_and_on_list --

-- TC305_not_on_string --
component A(name string)
<p :if={!name}>x</p>
-- TC306_if_not_bool --
